args: $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; Import-Module /opt/tools/parts/powershell/modules/PSScriptAnalyzer/PSScriptAnalyzer.psd1; $settings = @{}; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath '.powershell-psscriptanalyzer.psd1') { $settings.Settings = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath '.powershell-psscriptanalyzer.psd1').Path }; $found = foreach ($file in $args) { Invoke-ScriptAnalyzer -Path ([WildcardPattern]::Escape($file)) @settings }; ConvertTo-Json -Compress -InputObject @($found | ForEach-Object { [pscustomobject]@{ file = $_.ScriptPath; line = $_.Line; column = $_.Column; rule = $_.RuleName; level = [string]$_.Severity; message = $_.Message } })

governed.config: PSScriptAnalyzer reads the project's .powershell-psscriptanalyzer.psd1 settings file (rules to include or exclude), else it runs every default rule: the project decides the rules

en.label: PSScriptAnalyzer (PowerShell)
en.purpose: The static checker for PowerShell scripts and modules: best practices, safe commands, naming, security and parse errors.
en.limitation: It runs under PowerShell in the tools image, one file at a time, and reads the project's .powershell-psscriptanalyzer.psd1 when there is one; without it every default rule applies.
en.needs: Nothing beyond the tools image (PowerShell and the module are in it): no network and no project dependencies.

pt-BR.label: PSScriptAnalyzer (PowerShell)
pt-BR.purpose: O verificador estático de scripts e módulos PowerShell: boas práticas, comandos seguros, nomes, segurança e erros de sintaxe.
pt-BR.limitation: Roda sob o PowerShell da imagem de ferramentas, um arquivo por vez, e lê o .powershell-psscriptanalyzer.psd1 do projeto quando existe; sem ele valem todas as regras padrão.
pt-BR.needs: Nada além da imagem de ferramentas (o PowerShell e o módulo já estão nela): sem rede e sem as dependências do projeto.
